signature: public Flux<TelemetryRecord> findLatestInRange(String deviceId, String metric, Instant from, Instant to)
body:
String sql = "SELECT r.device_id, r.metric, r.t_device, r.t_ingress, r.\"value\", r.validation_status, r.revision "
        + "FROM telemetry_records r "
        + "WHERE r.device_id = :pDeviceId AND r.metric = :pMetric AND r.t_device >= :pFrom AND r.t_device <= :pTo "
        + "AND r.revision = (SELECT MAX(m.revision) FROM telemetry_records m "
        + "WHERE m.device_id = r.device_id AND m.metric = r.metric AND m.t_device = r.t_device) "
        + "ORDER BY r.t_device ASC";
return databaseClient.sql(sql)
        .bind("pDeviceId", deviceId)
        .bind("pMetric", metric)
        .bind("pFrom", from.atOffset(ZoneOffset.UTC))
        .bind("pTo", to.atOffset(ZoneOffset.UTC))
        .map((row, metadata) -> new TelemetryRecord(
                row.get("device_id", String.class),
                row.get("metric", String.class),
                toInstant(row.get("t_device")),
                toInstant(row.get("t_ingress")),
                ((Number) row.get("value")).doubleValue(),
                row.get("validation_status", String.class),
                ((Number) row.get("revision")).longValue()))
        .all();
members: @Override public Mono<TelemetryRecord> append(TelemetryRecord record) { return databaseClient.sql("INSERT INTO telemetry_records (device_id, metric, t_device, revision, \"value\", validation_status, t_ingress) VALUES (:pDeviceId, :pMetric, :pTDevice, :pRevision, :pValue, :pStatus, :pTIngress)").bind("pDeviceId", record.deviceId()).bind("pMetric", record.metric()).bind("pTDevice", record.tDevice().atOffset(ZoneOffset.UTC)).bind("pRevision", (int) record.revision()).bind("pValue", record.value()).bind("pStatus", record.status()).bind("pTIngress", record.tIngress().atOffset(ZoneOffset.UTC)).fetch().rowsUpdated().thenReturn(record); }

private static Instant toInstant(Object raw) { if (raw instanceof OffsetDateTime odt) { return odt.toInstant(); } if (raw instanceof ZonedDateTime zdt) { return zdt.toInstant(); } if (raw instanceof LocalDateTime ldt) { return ldt.toInstant(ZoneOffset.UTC); } return (Instant) raw; }
